chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār asked him:
About the young lamb: when does zakat become obligatory on it? He said, "When it reaches jadhaʿ."

key_terms.أَجْذَعَ: reached the age of jadhaʿ, a recognized livestock age threshold
key_terms.السَّخْلِ: young lambs or offspring of sheep/goats
key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: zakat, the obligatory alms in this context

ai.seo_question: When does zakat become obligatory on young lambs according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about when zakat becomes obligatory on young lambs. It states that the obligation applies when the animal reaches the stage of jadhaʿ, indicating a recognized age or developmental threshold in fiqh.
